l2_pmr.quote: Partial metabolic response (PMR) by Lugano 2014, which NCCN would call a partial response. This is not a complete metabolic response.

l2_repeat_biopsy.quote: Repeat biopsy, redesigned to answer the question.

l2_respect_refusal.quote: Respect the informed refusal. Document the discussion: the risk of undetected residual lymphoma, that without tissue we cannot confirm remission, that the choice of further treatment depends on tissue, and that the offer to biopsy stays open.

l2_short_interval_pet_or_rt.quote: I recommend consolidative radiotherapy: 30 Gy in 15 fractions to the residual retroperitoneal mass with a margin, IMRT planning to limit bowel, kidney and ureteric dose, referred to radiation oncology.

l2_no_cns_action.quote: No CNS-directed treatment is needed now. Reasons: MRI brain with and without gadolinium on 2026-09-25 shows no intracranial mass

l2_car_t_awareness.quote: Interpretation: viable DLBCL means primary refractory disease, not complete remission. Refer to CAR-T evaluation (axi-cel is approved for primary refractory DLBCL within 12 months of first-line therapy, and he is 67 with ECOG 1, so he is worth referring)

l2_mn_declares_cure.quote: This is not a complete metabolic response.

l2_mn_salvage_without_histology.quote: Do not give further systemic chemotherapy, transplant or maintenance on the basis of an unconfirmed residual, because the toxicity cost is high and the benefit unknown.
